{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to completed orders only
completed_only = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast
completed_only['revenue_float'] = completed_only['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99) in completed set
qa_in_completed = completed_only[completed_only['revenue_float'] == 999999.99]

# Remove QA orders from the completed set
clean_completed = completed_only[completed_only['revenue_float'] != 999999.99]

# Compute conversion rate by customer_segment on clean data
conversion_rates_clean = clean_completed.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].agg(['count', 'sum'])
conversion_rates_clean['conversion_rate'] = conversion_rates_clean['sum'] / conversion_rates_clean['count']
conversion_rates_clean_sorted = conversion_rates_clean.sort_values('conversion_rate', ascending=False)

# Get the segment with highest conversion rate
highest_segment_clean = conversion_rates_clean_sorted.index[0]

# Output the full table for evidence
print(conversion_rates_clean_sorted)

# Final answer
print(f'Highest conversion rate segment: {highest_segment_clean}')"}
